justification: CDP4 reports one Coal column while the NGER cross-walk carries separate black and brown factors; the two are within 4 per cent of each other, so the blend moves the coal factor by at most 0.9 per cent against either pure coal.
key: Share of coal generation taken as black coal

basis: Authored convention reused from the demand plan topic
justification: Behind-the-meter rooftop output never crosses the NEM, so the remainder is the closest proxy these generation-basis files offer for grid-supplied energy, and it matches the basis the campaign's own fleet intensity is quoted on.
value: Every CDP4 fuel column less Solar (Rooftop)

basis: Technology substitution within the IASR table (S003 and S004)
justification: The IASR heat rate table identifies units by technology rather than fuel and CDP4 names no liquid-fuelled class, so distillate takes the plant class the NGER cross-walk names as the diesel-burning part of the fleet; distillate is zero in every plotted year anyway.
used_for: Converting CDP4 distillate generation to fuel energy

short_name: gas heat rate as a unit-count median
basis: Median over the gas-fuelled IASR units (S004)
justification: A median over 48 units leans towards the many small peakers rather than the combined-cycle plant supplying most gas energy; substituting the combined-cycle median of 7.67 moves Step Change in 2030 by 1.3 per cent, so the lean does not change what the band shows.
used_for: Converting CDP4 gas generation to fuel energy

short_name: derived series stands in for an AEMO emissions series
justification: AEMO publishes only cumulative megatonne budgets, which cannot be placed on a per-year intensity axis, so the overlay is derived from published generation and NGER factors and back-checked against the 2024 outturn (S005).
value: A derived series, not an AEMO-published one
